text:
ash: Heads-up: planning to enable arcadia-13b-q6 (new quant profile) in the catalog during the 01:00-04:00 UTC change window on 2026-05-12. Goal: ~25% token-cost reduction for standard traffic. Canary suggestion: 2% (20m) -> 8% (30m) -> 25% (40m) -> 100%. Need fallback ordering, tier pins, rollback criteria, and a short release blurb.
deploybot: @ash scheduled route 'catalog:arcadia-13b-q6-canary' for 2026-05-12T01:00:00Z. Auto-promote unless a :hold: reaction within 20m. I will attach metric hooks: p95_latency, error_rate, token_mismatch_rate, and a content-regression eval webhook.
marie: Recommend top fallback = arcadia-13b-fp16 for all SLA routes. Secondary fallback = arcadia-13b-q4 (previous quant). Tertiary = regional-default. Also propose tier pin: reserved_capacity & enterprise -> fp16.
sre-ops: Rollback triggers proposal: p95 latency increase >20% over baseline sustained 10m OR error_rate >0.35% sustained 5m. Add immediate short-circuit: tokenization mismatch >0.25% across canary traffic -> instant rollback. Add a content-regression guard: eval-set perplexity increase >5% -> pause promotion and alert.
product: Tiny note for customers: include compatibility note about subtle tokenization differences for prompts that include legacy control characters. We'll coordinate customer comms with enterprise success.
devex: I'll draft SDK note for `model_variant_preference` behavior and fallback precedence. Need to know exact param name for the rollout yaml so docs and SDK match.
ops-bot: Commit created: rollouts/3155556666-arcadia-enable.yaml (contains canary steps, fallback_chain, tier_pins, alerts).
marie: Also suggest fallback TTL policy: if a route stays on fallback for >7 minutes continuously, auto-tag the rollout and create a task for follow-up. Don't let users live on fallback indefinitely.
nash: (typo -> ash) thanks, correcting.
nash: sorry for the name glitch. Confirming: default fallback order: [arcadia-13b-fp16 (top), arcadia-13b-q4, regional-default]. Tier pins as marie. Canary cadence as above. rollbacks per sre-ops.
deploybot: Will create tier pin entries and the canary route. Hooking automated rollback to p95/error/tokenization thresholds and content regression webhook. Will send summary to #runbook and tag rollout=arcadia-13b-q6, window=2026-05-12-01:00-04:00Z.
sre-ops: I'll monitor from 00:45-04:30 UTC. Manual rollback command validated in staging: `/deploybot rollback catalog arcadia-13b-q6 --reason "manual-observe"`.
product: We'll prepare an enterprise mailing note and a short blurb for the release notes. Product will own customer notifications if there is a rollback that affects reserved capacity.
devex: Draft pushed to PR #2621 with SDK snippet showing `model_variant_preference` ordering and fallback explanation.
marie: Also: set repeated-fallback protection — if a specific route falls back 4 times within 20 minutes, pause promotions and escalate to oncall.
oncall: oncall ACK, I'll be present in #runbook and will coordinate if we need to exec rollback.
deploybot: Canary created and scheduled. Webhooks and alerts in place. Posting condensed summary to #runbook.
nash: Thanks all. Reminder: keep mobile alerts on during the window and ping if you see noisy signals.
